item.title: Building a ChatGPT Data Pipeline with RisingWave Stream Processor and Astra Vector Search
item.description: Enter the exciting brave new world of GenAI, by building a ChatGPT Data Pipeline that leverages on RisingWave’s efficient stream processing write jobs for real-time market data that’s been enriched with Astra/Cassandra’s high performant vector embedding and similarity search.
